items.summary: CFO recommendation: approve containment-only execution and reject any new spend, monetization expansion, revenue forecast, ROI claim, or queue admission this cycle. The only supported revenue evidence is Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 aggregate clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The $4.92 is provider-aggregate and cannot be assigned to a site; site-attributed income is $0. Do not treat clicks, orders, conversions, or impressions as revenue or margin.

Finance disposition: September 1-30 AI usage is $950.44418695 across 5,316 calls, with 229 errors and 5 transient errors; this is approximately $0.1789 per call, but cost-to-learn is unknown because no approved learning threshold or experiment-level allocated cost exists. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, infrastructure spend, and total budget exposure are also unknown: the brief has no matching-period allocated revenue ledger, infrastructure/domain/hosting costs, labor allocation, or populated monthly spend limit, fixed-cost, or marketing-budget fields. Minimum measurement is one dated period-aligned ledger mapping each site and work item to revenue by registered tracking ID, AI cost, infrastructure/domain/hosting costs, and approved learning threshold. Existing telemetry is sufficient for this reconciliation; do not request duplicate data or extrapolate one revenue day against September AI spend.

Retain the allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as a slot-gated, reportable experiment after existing repair work clears. Its available evidence is 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Measure outbound CTR, orders, shipped items, and registered-tracking-ID commission, but do not claim financial lift unless revenue attribution and a predeclared learning threshold are available. Defer MarkItDown research until the finance ledger and current AI-spend controls establish that additional learning spend is justified.
